definitions.gloss: pick-up artist; man who habitually hits on strangers
definitions.explanation: A man skilled at, or in the habit of, approaching and picking up people he does not know, especially women in public places. Casual and often disparaging.

examples.japanese: {街|まち}でナンパ{師|し}に{声|こえ}をかけられた。
examples.english: A pick-up artist hit on me in town.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}はナンパ{師|し}が{多|おお}いから{気|き}をつけたほうがいい。
examples.english: That place attracts a lot of pick-up artists, so you'd better be careful.

notes:
USAGE: ナンパ{師|し} combines {ナンパ} (picking someone up romantically) with the suffix {師|し} (a person skilled in an activity). It is casual and usually carries a negative or joking tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナンパ{師|し}に{引|ひ}っかかる: to fall for a pick-up artist
- {自称|じしょう}ナンパ{師|し}: a self-proclaimed pick-up artist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {ナンパ}: hitting on someone — the act itself
- {遊|あそ}び{人|にん}: a playboy — someone who plays around romantically
